$comment: SEC-09 launch handshake, shared by the TypeScript and Swift test suites. main sends challenge{nonce: serverNonce}; the Helper answers hello{nonce: clientNonce, proof: HMAC-SHA256(secret, "emperor-helper-hello\0" + serverNonce + "\0" + clientNonce)}; main answers welcome{proof: HMAC-SHA256(secret, "emperor-main-welcome\0" + serverNonce + "\0" + clientNonce)}. All values are lowercase hex; the secret arrives on the Helper stdin as 64 hex digits and a newline.
